status: PARTIAL: implementation and cached reruns completed; independent final approval and source certification are separate

findings.issue: Legacy single-stock fees were deducted from period-end returns and baskets always paid 20bp even without full turnover
findings.correction: Use existing portfolio_accounting solver before investing; drift actual holdings; make cash and zero-wealth states explicit

findings.issue: Regime filter repeatedly charged a sell fee in consecutive cash months and did not recompute re-entry costs
findings.correction: Reconstruct filtered targets from asset-level ledger and replay actual costs/holdings

findings.issue: SMA200/SMA50/short volatility/max daily return/smooth windows could cross identity or source segments
findings.correction: Require each full lookback window to stay in one price segment

findings.issue: A late old-quarter publication could overwrite a newer known fiscal period; latest undefined values could revive old valid growth
findings.correction: Keep only monotone fiscal updates by CIK and retain publicly available NaN states

findings.issue: Unknown source-gap/terminal outcomes were treated as known ML training labels
findings.correction: Preserve all formation rows and baseline return assumptions, but mask their forward training ranks; retain unresolved counts in portfolio ledgers
findings.actual: 24 unknown labels among 99,949 panel rows; 834 stocks, 201 formations

findings.issue: ML deflated Sharpe shortcut omitted return skew/kurtosis adjustment
findings.correction: Use existing backtest.deflated_sharpe on matching monthly excess returns; label only 12 primary frozen trials, not the entire research history
findings.limitation: No evidence of strategy selection skill is established by this statistic

findings.issue: Only selected ML candidates had holdout artifacts and top5/top20 had no auditable holdings
findings.correction: Run all six already declared models and four existing portfolio rules on retrospective holdout; save all 48 dev/holdout asset ledgers without changing development-only choice

findings.issue: Twelve-month diagnostic outcomes used formations whose labels extended after the development cutoff
findings.correction: Limit each diagnostic target to formations whose full horizon ends by its stated development/test cutoff

findings.issue: Fixed explosive factors selected through 2022 were retrospectively applied to 2012/2015 returns; negative-factor ranks had inconsistent offsets with missing-factor averages
findings.correction: Label development-fitted histories explicitly, set valid comparison start to 2023 for fixed factors, and put signed percentile ranks on a common 0..1 scale; annual reselection stays separately identified

findings.issue: Risk report spread unexplained monthly endpoint differences smoothly across daily prices, creating an invented daily NAV
findings.correction: Require observed gross endpoints and initial fees to reconcile; terminal/source events and unobserved daily cash paths mark daily metrics unavailable instead of rescaling
findings.actual: 4 of 18 v3 daily paths reconcile; 14 unavailable. Monthly metrics remain available

findings.issue: Old explosive panel cache silently bypassed new feature/label code
findings.correction: Rebuild derived panel from corrected inputs, with per-command source/output fingerprints and real process exit status

findings.issue: Malformed calendars or negative/NaN portfolio weights could silently omit months or targets
findings.correction: Reject duplicate/missing month-end schedules and invalid weights; caller supplies explicit cash months

findings.issue: Forward fill silently treated missing intra-month held quotes as observed prices
findings.correction: Reject any nonfinite/nonpositive held quote; no fill; no observed path claim for incomplete marks
findings.actual: Only risk_report rerun; all 83 monthly ledger hashes unchanged. Four existing observed paths had no missing marks, so existing daily values/statuses also unchanged.

failed_attempts: bundled Python lacked parquet engine; reran with existing system Python
first risk report CSV parsed a single weight as float; fixed scalar parsing and completed final rerun
actual_execution.concurrent_source_notes: Run manifest hashes all sibling Python files, so unrelated writer changes are recorded. Legacy helper gained strict input validation during dev; 83 resulting ledgers pass final calendar/finite-weight/cost-balance checks. No input panel was changed after the final features/explosive/EAR stages.

limitations: Cached data was reused; no network downloads or raw archive changes were made by this writer.
PIT membership, historical industries, SEC raw identities, source coverage and terminal prices are not fully certified.
Same-formation-close execution is idealised. Monthly close risk is not intraday risk.
Terminal payouts/last-trade exits retain the shared engine's baseline assumptions; no new unverified payout or terminal fee is invented.
Fixed explosive factor sets selected on development history are eligible for temporal comparison only from 2023.
ML development and holdout ledgers start independently from cash. They were not concatenated as a fake continuous portfolio.
All evaluated history was already seen in this project; these reruns are retrospective, not fresh untouched holdouts.
workflow: frozen cached inputs -> corrected features and labels -> actual model/portfolio reruns -> 83 checked ledgers -> 59 strategy records -> independent review and source limitations
